item.description: >normal healthy gamer sees a complex character creator: "Oh my god... wait. I can be anything in this game? I can be a warrior with huge shoulders, scars across his face, braided beard... I want his visual to really show he's a toon that survived hundreds of battles... Or maybe... Maybe I can be a mage! Long silver hair, glowing blue eyes, runes tattooed up my arms... I can even pick the color of my aura. Purple. Definitely purple."
